name: CMS Energy Corporation
reason: Regulated Michigan electric/gas utility with 6.7% 10y EPS CAGR, net debt/EBITDA 6.0x, 10y avg ROIC 4.2% and persistently negative FCF; reliable but ordinary regulated growth, consistent with other utilities marked NO.

name: PC Connection, Inc.
reason: Low-margin IT reseller (EBIT margin 3.7%, revenue CAGR 1.1% over 10y) with no moat; net cash and FCF are real but this is a cheap-but-ordinary middleman, like CDW/SNX/SCSC.

name: Americold Realty Trust, Inc.
reason: Cold-storage REIT with net debt/EBITDA 7.9x, shares up 15%/yr over 10y, acquisitions at 1.6x FCF and FFO/share flat since 2017 (1.13 to 1.43) amid industry oversupply.

name: Cencora, Inc.
reason: Oligopoly US drug wholesaler (with MCK/CAH) with adjusted EPS up every year (12.4% 10y CAGR, 9/10 years >=7%), shares shrinking 1.1%/yr, net debt/EBITDA 1.05x and consensus ~10-12% growth; Walgreens concentration and drug-pricing policy must be tested in the deep dive, and the 57% adjusted/GAAP gap (opioid charges) noted.

name: Copart, Inc.
reason: Salvage-auction duopoly with owned land moat, 35% EBIT margin, 10y avg ROIC 23%, net cash (-2.3x) and 19% 10y EPS CAGR with no acquisitions; growth has slowed (FY26 EPS -2.5%, consensus FY2-3 9%/8%) but total-loss frequency and international give a credible >=7% route.

name: Camden Property Trust
reason: Sunbelt apartment REIT with 4.2% 10y FFO/share CAGR, only 2/10 years of >=7% growth, net debt/EBITDA 4.3x and rents exposed to new supply cycles; ordinary real estate with no route to 7%.

name: CRA International, Inc.
reason: Strong record (22% 10y EPS CAGR, shares -3.1%/yr) but EPS and EBIT margin are at 10y highs (11.1% vs 7.8% avg, 100th pctile) in a people business tied to M&A/antitrust enforcement activity, so the current margin is hard to underwrite.

name: Custom Truck One Source Inc
reason: Cyclical, PE-controlled truck/equipment rental and sales business with net debt/EBITDA 5.9x, negative GAAP EPS in 2024-25 and 10y avg ROIC -2.4%; FCF yield reflects rental-fleet capex timing, not durable earnings.

name: CTS Corporation
reason: Small sensors/components maker with 3.6% 10y revenue CAGR, heavy auto/industrial cyclicality, acquisitions at 0.64x FCF and 10y avg ROIC 6.9%; competent but not special.

name: CubeSmart
reason: Self-storage REIT whose FFO/share has fallen since 2023 (2.68 to 2.58), with consensus growth of ~1-3%, shares up 3%/yr and net debt/EBITDA 5.0x; no route to 7%.

name: California Water Service Group
reason: Regulated water utility with lumpy rate-case EPS (0.91 in 2023, 3.25 in 2024, 2.15 in 2025; 0.66x peak), negative FCF, net debt/EBITDA 4.6x and California wildfire/regulatory exposure.

name: Caesars Entertainment, Inc.
reason: Casino operator with net debt/EBITDA 7.1x, GAAP losses in 4 of the last 6 years, shares up 16%/yr from the Eldorado merger (acq/FCF 12.6x) and consumer-cyclical earnings; fails the balance-sheet test.

name: Dominion Energy Inc
reason: Utility with flat EPS over 10y (-0.1% CAGR; 3.42 in 2025 vs 3.44 in 2015), shares up 3.7%/yr, net debt/EBITDA 6.8x, negative FCF and offshore-wind execution risk.

name: Dave, Inc.
reason: Fintech whose earnings come from small-dollar cash advances to subprime consumers, profitable only since 2024, with high credit-cycle and CFPB/state regulatory risk; FCF yield reflects a brief record.

name: DuPont de Nemours, Inc.
reason: Serial portfolio transformation (Dow/Corteva splits, Qnity electronics spin, Aramids sale) leaves a business with 10y revenue CAGR -17.8%, EPS 0.69x 10y max and 10y avg ROIC 1.9%; the remaining company has no stable record to forecast from.

name: Dillard's, Inc.
reason: Department store in secular decline (10y revenue CAGR -0.3%) whose EPS jumped from 3.56 to 48.16 on post-COVID margins and is now normalising (34.13, 0.71x peak; consensus FY2 -13%); buybacks (shares -8.7%/yr) do not make it special.

name: Dell Technologies, Inc.
reason: EBIT margin at a 10y high (7.9%, 100th pctile) on an AI-server boom that consensus extrapolates (FY1 +152%), in low-margin, cyclical PC/server hardware with hyperscaler customer concentration; the earnings run-rate cannot be forecast with confidence.

name: Dollar General Corporation
reason: Dense rural small-box network is a real advantage, but EPS is 0.64x its 2022 peak, EBIT margin collapsed from 10.5% to 5.3% (18th pctile), net debt/EBITDA 4.4x and the turnaround under a returning CEO is unproven.

name: Diodes Incorporated
reason: Commodity-like discrete/analog semiconductor maker with EPS at 0.17x its 2022 peak and EBIT margin swinging 20.2% to 2.5%; earnings are set by the semiconductor inventory cycle.

name: DraftKings, Inc.
reason: Online sportsbook only just at breakeven (EBIT margin 0.0%, 10y avg ROIC -41.5%) with state gaming-tax hikes, prediction-market competition and promotional intensity making long-run margins unforecastable.
